# Synthesia – AI video communications platform

> Synthesia is an AI video communications platform used by L&D, enablement, HR, and internal-communications teams at large, multi-region enterprises to create, localize, and scale business video without cameras, studios, actors, or agencies. It spans five product lines: **AI video creation** — turn scripts, PowerPoint, documents, or prompts into training, onboarding, compliance, explainer, SOP, internal-comms, and marketing videos in 160+ languages; **Roleplay Sessions** — practice sales roleplays, cold-call and discovery practice, objection handling, support simulations, manager training, and difficult-conversation or compliance scenarios with an AI avatar that gives conversational coaching feedback; **Survey Sessions** — collect richer feedback through natural, spoken interviews in which an AI avatar asks questions, listens to each response, follows up where more detail would be useful, and organizes the results into structured insights; **AI Dubbing & Video Translation** — dub and translate existing training, comms, and marketing videos into 140+ languages with lip-sync and voice cloning for regional audiences; and **Interactive Avatars** — real-time AI avatars for live conversations, available through an API for custom applications or a fully managed Widget for websites. Teams choose Synthesia for high-quality AI avatars and motion graphics, enterprise-grade security and compliance (SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, 27701, and 42001, UK Cyber Essentials, GDPR, EU data residency, SSO/SAML), SCORM/LMS export, fast script-edit-and-regenerate iteration versus re-shoots, brand-kit consistency for non-designers, and responsive customer support. Used by 1M+ users and 90% of the Fortune 100.

## Basic Information
- [What is Synthesia](https://help.synthesia.io/en/articles/9994493-what-is-synthesia): Knowledge Base overview of Synthesia as an AI video communications platform for enterprise L&D, enablement, HR, and comms teams — covering its five product lines (AI video creation, Roleplay Sessions, Survey Sessions, AI Dubbing & Video Translation, Interactive Avatars), who it’s for, common use cases, key capabilities, enterprise security, how it compares, limitations, and plans.
- [Pricing](https://www.synthesia.io/pricing): Plans and pricing for individuals, teams, and enterprises, including free and paid options, usage limits, collaboration features, and enterprise capabilities.
- [Enterprise](https://www.synthesia.io/enterprise): Enterprise-grade AI video creation for large organizations, with security, governance, SSO/SAML, admin controls, collaboration, support, and scalable deployment options.
- [Trust Center](https://security.synthesia.io/): Security, privacy, and compliance documentation for enterprise buyers and IT/security reviews — SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, 27701, and 42001 (the first ISO 42001 certification for an AI video platform), UK Cyber Essentials, GDPR, and EU data residency, with customer data stored in the EU (AWS, Ireland).
- [About Synthesia](https://www.synthesia.io/about): Information about Synthesia’s company mission, founding story, leadership, and approach to making video creation more accessible.
- [Product Updates](https://www.synthesia.io/updates): Recent product releases, feature improvements, platform updates, and fixes shipped by Synthesia.
- [All Tools](https://www.synthesia.io/tools): Directory of Synthesia’s free AI tools for creating, editing, translating, and enhancing video, audio, scripts, images, and other media assets.

## AI Video Creation
- [AI Video Generator](https://www.synthesia.io/features/ai-video-generator): Create AI-generated videos from prompts, scripts, documents, links, or other inputs — combining AI avatars with AI-generated B-roll, images, and motion graphics — then edit and refine them in Synthesia.
- [Text to Video](https://www.synthesia.io/features/text-to-video): Turn written text into professional videos with AI avatars, voiceovers, AI-generated B-roll and motion graphics, and editable video layouts.
- [PowerPoint to Video](https://www.synthesia.io/powerpoint-to-video): Convert PowerPoint presentations and SOPs into narrated videos (slide-to-video, SOP-to-video), using slide content and speaker notes as the basis for a video script.
- [AI Avatars](https://www.synthesia.io/features/avatars): Use realistic AI avatars as on-screen presenters, including stock avatars, custom avatars, and more flexible avatar creation options.
- [Custom Avatar](https://www.synthesia.io/features/custom-avatar): Create a personal or branded AI avatar that can present video content without repeated filming.
- [AI Voice Generator](https://www.synthesia.io/features/ai-voice-generator): Generate natural-sounding AI voiceovers from text in many languages, accents, and voice styles.
- [160+ Languages](https://www.synthesia.io/features/languages): Create AI videos and voiceovers in 160+ languages for video localization and multilingual training, with multilingual voice and caption options for global audiences.
- [AI Voice Cloning](https://www.synthesia.io/features/ai-voice-cloning): Create an AI version of a voice for consistent narration across videos, subject to Synthesia’s consent and safety controls.
- [AI Screen Recorder](https://www.synthesia.io/features/ai-screen-recorder): Record screen-based walkthroughs and screencasts (screen recordings, job aids, how-to/process videos) and combine them with AI narration, avatars, motion graphics, and other video elements.
- [AI Video Assistant](https://help.synthesia.io/en/articles/13759605-how-do-i-create-a-video-using-assistant): Create videos faster by generating a draft video from prompts, documents, links, or ideas.
- [Brand Kits](https://docs.synthesia.io/docs/brand-kits): Keep videos on-brand with reusable logos, colors, fonts, and branded assets.
- [Collaboration](https://help.synthesia.io/en/articles/8372826-how-can-i-collaborate-with-others): Work with teammates on video projects using shared workspaces, commenting, review, and editing workflows.

## Roleplay Sessions
- [Roleplay Sessions](https://www.synthesia.io/sessions/roleplays): Practice sales, service, and difficult conversations (AI coaching, sales simulation) with an AI avatar that gives conversational coaching feedback alongside scoring, plus a separate coach persona and SCORM/LMS embedding.

## Survey Sessions
- [Survey Sessions](https://www.synthesia.io/sessions/surveys): Collect information through natural, spoken conversations instead of static forms. An AI avatar asks the creator’s questions, follows up where more detail would be useful, and organizes results into an AI-generated report, individual responses, transcripts, audio, and question-by-question analysis. Common use cases include employee onboarding feedback, exit interviews, pulse-survey follow-ups, customer churn and win-loss interviews, product feedback, customer-satisfaction deep-dives, and lead qualification.

## AI Dubbing & Video Translation
- [AI Dubbing](https://www.synthesia.io/features/ai-dubbing): Dub existing videos into 140+ languages with lip-sync and voice cloning that preserves each speaker’s voice — faster than agencies, with editable transcripts before dubbing.
- [Video Translator](https://www.synthesia.io/features/video-translator): Translate videos (video translation, one-click translation) into 140+ languages with lip-sync, cloned voices, and auto-generated subtitles.

## Interactive Avatars
- [Interactive Avatars](https://www.synthesia.io/features/avatars/interactive-avatars): Create real-time AI avatars that listen, respond, and lip-sync during live conversations. Developers can use the Interactive Avatars API to connect a Synthesia avatar to their existing AI agent while retaining control of their LLM, knowledge base, voice, and workflows. Teams can also use the fully managed Interactive Avatars Widget to create a knowledge-grounded agent in Synthesia and embed it on a website without building or hosting the underlying AI stack.

## Comparisons & Customer Proof
- [Alternatives & Comparisons](https://www.synthesia.io/alternatives): How Synthesia compares to alternatives such as HeyGen, Colossyan, and Veed — positioned as the only platform covering the full workflow (create, localize, manage, publish, engage) in one tool.
- [Customer Reviews](https://www.synthesia.io/reviews): 100+ categorized quotes from real customer reviews (4.7/5 from 2,000+ G2 reviews) across change management, sales enablement, operations training, internal communications, and employee training.
- [Case Studies](https://www.synthesia.io/case-studies): Customer stories showing how organizations use Synthesia to create, localize, and scale video content.

## Use Cases
- [Learning & Development](https://www.synthesia.io/learning-and-development): Create and update employee training, onboarding, compliance, enablement, and instructional videos at scale.
- [Sales Enablement](https://www.synthesia.io/sales-enablement): Create sales training, onboarding, product education, roleplay practice, and enablement content for revenue teams.
- [Information Technology](https://www.synthesia.io/information-technology): Create IT training, security awareness, software rollout, change management, and internal support videos.
- [Knowledge Managers](https://www.synthesia.io/knowledge-managers): Turn internal knowledge, documentation, SOPs, and process guidance into clear, searchable video content.
- [Human Resources](https://www.synthesia.io/human-resources): Create HR onboarding, compliance, and policy-update videos, localized for distributed workforces.

## Resources
- [Video Templates](https://www.synthesia.io/video-templates): Ready-made video templates for training, sales, marketing, internal communications, onboarding, compliance, and other business needs.
- [Blog](https://www.synthesia.io/blog): Articles, guides, examples, and best practices on AI video, workplace learning, communication, localization, and content creation.
- [AI in L&D Report 2026](https://www.synthesia.io/reports/ai-in-learning-and-development-report-2026): Research on how learning and development teams are adopting AI and using it to improve workplace training.

## Documentation
- [Help Center](https://help.synthesia.io/en/): Support articles and how-to guides for creating, editing, translating, publishing, sharing, and managing videos in Synthesia.
- [Developer Documentation](https://docs.synthesia.io): Documentation for developers building with Synthesia, including product guides, API documentation, SDKs, webhooks, and changelogs.
- [API Reference](https://docs.synthesia.io/reference/introduction): Technical reference for using the Synthesia API to create videos, manage assets, work with templates, handle dubbing or translation jobs, and integrate with external systems.
- [API Quickstart](https://docs.synthesia.io/reference/synthesia-api-quickstart): Step-by-step guide for creating a first AI video with the Synthesia API.

## Integrations
- [All Integrations](https://docs.synthesia.io/docs/synthesia-integrations): Overview of Synthesia’s integrations, embed options, automation workflows, and supported third-party tools.
- [PowerPoint](https://docs.synthesia.io/docs/powerpoint): Technical guide to importing .pptx files into Synthesia — supported formats, how slides and speaker notes are mapped, and import limitations.
- [Docebo](https://docs.synthesia.io/docs/docebo): Add Synthesia videos to Docebo learning experiences and training courses for enterprise L&D, onboarding, compliance, and employee training workflows.
- [Workday](https://docs.synthesia.io/docs/workday): Sync employee data from Workday into Synthesia’s Learner Portal to support enterprise rollout, learner assignment, and training management.
- [Zapier](https://docs.synthesia.io/reference/guide-synthesia-zapier): Automate Synthesia video creation and distribution across thousands of business apps without custom code.
- [Articulate 360](https://docs.synthesia.io/docs/articulate-360): Add Synthesia videos to Articulate 360 e-learning courses and instructional content.
- [SAP Litmos](https://docs.synthesia.io/docs/sap-litmos): Use Synthesia videos in SAP Litmos for employee training, onboarding, compliance, and learning programs.

## Optional
- [Responsible AI](https://www.synthesia.io/responsible-ai): Synthesia’s principles for responsible AI video generation, including consent, control, transparency, and safeguards against misuse.
- [AI Governance](https://www.synthesia.io/ai-governance): Synthesia’s governance framework for building and deploying AI video technology safely and responsibly.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.synthesia.io/legal/privacy-policy): How Synthesia collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data.
- [Customer Terms of Service](https://www.synthesia.io/legal/customer-terms-of-service): Legal terms that govern customer use of Synthesia products and services.
- [Security Practices](https://www.synthesia.io/legal/security-practices): Details on the technical, organizational, and physical controls Synthesia uses to protect customer data.

You’ve likely got a few questions

Is Synthesia free?

Yes, our Basic plan is free, with no credit card required. You can choose from our stock avatars, give them any outfit or scene you like, or design your own with Avatar Builder. Then you can generate videos in 140+ languages. You get 500 credits a month, enough for up to 10 minutes of video or 10 minutes of AI Dubbing. Compare all available plans or try our free AI video generator.

What can I do with Synthesia?

Synthesia is an AI video platform for business. You can create and manage professional video at scale, have real two-way conversations with realistic Interactive Avatars, and build our AI video technology into your own product.

Video:

  • Create: Describe what you need to Assistant, or start from a PowerPoint, document, or link, and get a finished draft with a script, scenes, and an avatar presenter. Choose from hundreds of AI avatars, design your own with Avatar Builder, or present as yourself with a Personal Avatar.
  • Translate: Make videos in 140+ languages, translate finished videos with 1-Click Translation, and dub any existing video with AI Dubbing in the original speaker's voice.
  • Manage: Keep every video on brand with Brand Kits, edit together in real time with Live Collaboration, and organize content across teams in shared workspaces.
  • Publish: Share by link, embed anywhere, or export to your LMS with SCORM. Videos update automatically when you edit them, and Analytics shows you who's watching and where they drop off.
  • Engage: Add quizzes, clickable CTAs, and branching paths so viewers do more than watch.

Sessions:

  • Roleplay Sessions: Practice hard conversations, like cold calls or tough feedback, with an avatar that responds and pushes back, then get coached and scored in real time.
  • Survey Sessions: Get the depth of an interview with the reach of a form. An avatar asks your questions and follows up on what people actually say. You get back themes and sentiment across every response, plus full transcripts.

Build:

  • API: Generate videos programmatically with the Synthesia API, or add real-time Interactive Avatars to your own product, website, or support flow with the Interactive Avatars API.

Teams use Synthesia to create training videos, onboard new hires, enable sales teams, share internal updates, gather customer insight, and support customers.

Can I create an AI avatar of myself?

Yes. Upload a single photo or a short video, and we'll build a Personal Avatar that looks like you. You can put it in any outfit or space and have it present any script. You can also clone your voice to go with it. Every Personal Avatar needs a live, on-camera consent recording, so no one can make an avatar of you without your permission.

Can I translate and dub my videos into other languages?

Yes. You can make any Synthesia video in 140+ languages and voices. Once a video is finished, 1-Click Translation turns it into other languages without rebuilding it. You can also translate videos made outside Synthesia by uploading a file or pasting a YouTube link. The dubbed version keeps the original speaker's voice and accent. Lip sync is optional, and a Custom Glossary keeps brand terms and product names consistent. Each dub keeps the speaker's own voice with matching lip sync.

What are Sessions?

Sessions are real, back-and-forth conversations with a lifelike avatar, at any scale.

  • Roleplay Sessions: Your team practices hard conversations, like cold calls or tough feedback, with an avatar that pushes back, then gets coached and scored in real time.
  • Survey Sessions: An avatar asks your questions, follows up on what people say, and hands back themes and sentiment across every response.

Can I customize AI videos to add brand identity?

Yes. You can add your logo, colors, and fonts, and upload your own images, footage, and voiceovers. Brand Kits apply your company's style to every video your team creates. You can dress avatars in branded outfits and place them in your own spaces, or create a brand mascot with Avatar Builder.

Does Synthesia integrate with my LMS?

Yes. Synthesia is designed to work with your existing Learning Management System (LMS). You can embed videos directly into your courses and training modules, or export them as SCORM packages, including every translated version. Embedded videos update automatically when you edit them, so you don't have to re-upload them every time your training changes. See the full list of integrations.

Is it safe for businesses to create AI videos in Synthesia?

Yes. Synthesia is SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and ISO 42001 certified, and GDPR compliant, with EU data residency. Enterprise teams get SSO and SCIM for access control. Every video goes through content moderation, and no one's likeness becomes an avatar without their explicit consent. Read more about our security and responsible AI policies.
